quote: Agents in text games operate—perceiving, acting in, and speaking to others in a world—entirely using textual natural language.

We train two BART models … the first takes as input character and location information and produces a short motivation … the second … produces the sequence of LIGHT game engine executable actions needed to achieve the motivation.

We focus on creating agents in LIGHT , a large-scale crowdsourced fantasy text-adventure game, consisting of rich textual worlds-locations, objects, and characters with personas, and quests-motivations for each character.
